entries.hook: What if you could create a client‑ready mood board in 5 minutes?
entries.angle: Showcase AI as a time‑saving tool that delivers high‑impact visual concepts for fast‑paced designers.
entries.prompt_text:
Create an Instagram carousel (5‑7 slides) that walks Creative Professionals through a real‑world project where Aimagix Studio used generative AI to speed up mood‑boarding for an Indian fashion brand.

entries.title: Eco‑Brand Revamp: 45% Sales Surge
entries.label: HIGH
entries.angle: Show measurable ROI for sustainable branding, appealing to Brand & Marketing Managers.
entries.prompt_text:
Create a 30‑second Instagram Reel that tells the rapid transformation of a Delhi sustainable‑packaging startup after partnering with Aimagix Studio.

1️⃣ **Teaser Loop (0‑15 sec)** – Start with a 3‑second loop of a hand‑sketched package morphing into a digital mock‑up, synced to a royalty‑free Bollywood‑style track (or properly licensed hit). Add a bold on‑screen caption: “30 sec to a greener brand”.

2️⃣ **Before (15‑5 sec)** – Flash the old generic packaging (0‑5 sec) while the beat drops.

3️⃣ **Process (5‑15 sec)** – Fast‑motion of Aimagix’s team (AI‑enhanced mood‑boarding + Madhubani‑inspired motifs) sketching, colour‑blocking, and applying recycled‑paper textures.

4️⃣ **After (15‑25 sec)** – Reveal the final brand kit: earthy palette, tactile recycled‑paper mock‑ups, and the #SustainableDesign badge.

5️⃣ **Result (25‑30 sec)** – Clip of the client saying, “Our sales jumped 45% in 8 weeks and we saved 30% on printing costs!” Overlay the metric graphics.

6️⃣ **CTA (final frame)** – Simple line: “DM for a free green audit 📩”. Include a QR‑code graphic that points to the link in bio (or the studio’s portfolio).

**Post‑Reel Follow‑Up**: In Stories, add a poll sticker – “Would you trust AI for mood‑boarding?” – to drive shares and comments. Schedule the Reel for Fri‑Sun 12‑13 PM CET (peak startup browsing) and cross‑promote the carousel case‑study in the caption.

Keep captions under 125 characters, use the trending hashtags, and enable the Reel’s “Save” CTA for future reference.
